// Part of the Dim Factory web starter. MIT License: copy, change and share it freely.
// Everything the site says lives here, so the words are easy to change in one place.
// [Fill in: ...] marks a fact only the owner knows (a name, opening hours, prices, an address, a quote from a
// customer). Replace it with the real fact; never make one up. The README lists what is still to fill in.

export interface NavItem {
  to: string
  label: string
}

export interface Feature {
  title: string
  text: string
  icon: 'spark' | 'heart' | 'clock'
}

export interface Update {
  id: string
  date: string
  title: string
  text: string
}
